menu.tutorial.hint: Learn every mechanic by playing (reviving, healing, equipment, calls, signs, goals). Your save is never touched.
tutorial.card.stuck: Stuck? Move on to the next room with {skip}.
tutorial.card.youDown: You are down! {name} is coming to revive you: stay put, this is not death.
tutorial.card.partnerDown: {name} is down! Go next to them and HOLD {action} to revive.
tutorial.card.reviveInterrupted: Revive interrupted: stay close to {name} and keep holding {action} until the end.
tutorial.end.title: Tutorial complete!
tutorial.end.body: You can move your hero, attack, interact, revive an ally, store and use a heart, share items and healing through automatic calls (heart, item left, accessory swap, red cross), call for help, read signs and follow the goals shown on screen.
tutorial.end.nosave: Nothing was saved: your progress is unchanged.
tutorial.end.solo: In a solo game, the plate marked B, reviving, calling (manual or automatic, red cross included) and healing an ally have no effect: they matter as soon as you play with two or more.
tutorial.end.press: Press {action} (or tap the screen) to go back to the menu.
tutorial.btn.move.keyboard: the arrow keys or W A S D (Z Q S D on an AZERTY keyboard)
tutorial.btn.move.gamepad: the left stick or the D-pad
tutorial.btn.move.gamepadPs: the left stick or the D-pad
tutorial.btn.call.touch: the X button (left corner of the diamond)
tutorial.btn.heart.touch: the B button (right corner of the diamond)
tutorial.btn.skip.touch: the chip on the right edge of the screen
tutorial.btn.pause.touch: the pause button at the top center
tutorial.step.welcome: Welcome! You play with {name}, a partner controlled by the game for two-player actions. Nothing is saved. Skip a step with {skip}; to leave: {pause}, then "Quit to menu".
tutorial.step.sign: Walk up to the sign and stay in front of it: signs tell you the room goal and give hints.
tutorial.step.roomGoals: Top right: the "Room goals" block ("Room goal" when there is only one line). It lists what you must do to open the exit: enemies to defeat, doors to open, personal goals completed (x/y).
tutorial.step.attack: A slime! Attack it with {attack} (hold to chain hits).
tutorial.step.personalGoal: Top left: "Your goal", specific to your hero. Here: defeat 2 enemies, the counter goes up with each finishing blow YOU deal. Keep fighting.
tutorial.step.hearts: Your hearts are your life. At zero you fall down: this is not death, an ally can revive you. Enemies sometimes drop a heart or half a heart: it goes into your heart slot (below your hearts, on the left) and YOU use it, whenever you decide. Nothing heals you on its own.
tutorial.step.special: Cast your special attack ({specialName}) with {special}: far stronger than a normal attack.
tutorial.step.specialRecharge: The gauge then recharges and shows READY. A special cannot be used non-stop: pick your moment.
tutorial.step.clearYard: Defeat all remaining enemies. The goals block tells you how many are left.
tutorial.step.exit.yard: The exit is open! Reach the exit zone on the right: every living hero must be inside.
tutorial.step.lever: A lever. Stand in front of it and use {interact}: the prompt shows at the bottom of the screen.
tutorial.step.plates: Two plates open the door together: {name} holds plate B, step on plate A. Follow the "Open" line at the top right.
tutorial.step.teamGoal: {name} has a personal goal too: the red lever. The goals block shows "completed x/y" and who we are waiting for. Everyone has a role!
tutorial.step.exit.workshop: Go through the door and reach the exit with {name}.
tutorial.step.block: Push the block onto the pedestal by walking into it. (In a real dungeon, two heroes push together.)
tutorial.step.keyPick: Walk onto the blue key to pick it up: it is personal and shows under your hearts.
tutorial.step.keyDoor: Stand in front of the door of the same color and use {interact} to open it with your key.
tutorial.step.exit.vault: Well done. Reach the exit with {name}.
tutorial.step.darkIntro: Dark room! Your torch burns down: its gauge is under your hearts. Lit braziers refill it.
tutorial.step.refuel: Go next to the lit brazier and use {interact} to refill your torch.
tutorial.step.lightBrazier: Now light the unlit brazier with {interact}: it lights the room and opens the exit.
tutorial.step.revive: {name} is about to fall. As soon as that happens, go next to them (if they are off screen, an arrow at the edge shows where) and HOLD {action} for about 3 seconds. If you let go, the revive starts over. Back on their feet, they will open the exit portcullis.
tutorial.step.exit.revive: They are back up! They pull the lever of the exit portcullis: reach the exit together.
tutorial.step.heartStore: Two half hearts appeared: walk over the first one, it is stored in your heart slot, below your hearts on the left. Walk over the second: two half hearts make a full heart! Nothing is consumed by touch, and the slot only holds ONE item (half a heart or a full heart).
tutorial.step.heartSelf: You are hurt! Press {heart} to use the stored heart: you recover 10 HP (5 for half a heart), never more than what you are missing. It is always YOU who decides, nothing is consumed by touch.
tutorial.step.heartAlly: {name} is hurt! Pick up the new heart, then stand ON {name} and press {heart}: you heal your ally with your heart (even if you are hurt too). A hurt ally within reach comes before you.
tutorial.step.heartFull: Your slot only holds ONE full heart. Pick up a first heart, then step on the second one: slot full, it stays on the ground and an automatic call alerts {name}: on their screen, the heart symbol replaces your dot. You do not see your own signal: watch {name} come and take the heart.
tutorial.step.exit.heart: Well done. Reach the exit with {name}.
tutorial.step.gearLeft: The armory. You already wear a level II protection (equipment row, under your hearts). Walk onto the level I protection lying on the ground: no stronger than yours, you do not pick it up. An AUTOMATIC CALL then starts: on the screen of {name}, who has nothing in that slot, the item symbol replaces your dot. You do not see your own signal: watch {name} come and take it.
tutorial.step.gearSwap: An accessory of a DIFFERENT kind lies on the ground: you never change accessory by accident. Stand on it and press {interact} to SWAP: the new one is equipped, the old one is dropped at your feet and an automatic call starts right away with its symbol (on the screen of {name}, who has no accessory). You do not see your own signal: watch {name} come and take it.
tutorial.step.exit.gear: Items well shared! Reach the exit with {name}.
tutorial.step.crossCall: A heart is stored in your slot. {name} just fell to 20% of their HP, far from you: a RED CROSS replaces their dot at the edge of your screen, with a small sound. It is a request for healing. Go near {name}, stand on {name} and press {heart} to heal them with your heart.
tutorial.step.crossWho: The red cross starts when a LIVING ally falls to 30% of their max HP or less (downed: no cross, they already have their arrow). It is seen ONLY by those who can heal: an ally whose heart slot holds a heart that would give them HP back, or Valentine (her healing arrow and her wave heal without a heart). If nobody can heal, nothing starts. It repeats every 10 s (Romain: 3 s) while the player stays at 30% or less; it is re-armed when they climb back to 60% or when a new room is entered.
tutorial.step.callReceive: {name} is far away, off screen, and is CALLING you: spot the signal at the screen edge (a dot and 3 arcs, in their color, with a sound). Head toward them.
tutorial.step.callSend: Your turn to call: {call}. You stand still for 1 s and the signal lasts 3 s; you can call again 5 s after pressing (Romain: as soon as the signal ends). Your allies see a dot and 3 arcs at the edge of their screen. A symbol in place of the dot = an AUTOMATIC call (item left, swap, healing): the recap further on details them.
tutorial.step.autoCallRecap2:
AUTOMATIC CALLS (2/2): who, how long, limits
- Who sees it: only the allies it helps (the item would suit them; heart: free slot or half; the cross: those who can heal, stored heart or Valentine). None concerned: no call.
- It lasts 3 s, does not freeze you and never prevents the manual call ({call}), which takes priority.
- Anti-spam: one call per item while you stay on it, about 4 s between two item calls; the cross repeats every 10 s while you stay at 30% or less.
- Never in solo, nor for an item locked for you (except the accessory you just swapped), nor for the equipment or the heart dropped when you fall; when downed, no cross (your arrow is enough).
tutorial.step.exit.call: Call received! Reach the exit with {name}.
tutorial.step.wipe: Watch: if all heroes fall at the same time, the room restarts. Cleared rooms and completed goals are kept. When you fall, your equipment and stored heart are lost.
tutorial.step.finalGoals: Last room: {name} holds the seal circle for 4 seconds. The sealed exit opens once the 4 personal goals are done (x/4).
tutorial.step.exit.final: The exit is open! Reach it to finish the tutorial.
tutorial.quit.confirm: Quit the tutorial? Nothing is saved and your progress is unchanged.
tutorial.wait.roomGoals: The goals block is about to appear at the top right…
tutorial.wait.refuel: Walk through the dark room: your torch has to burn down a little first…
tutorial.wait.heartSelf: Pick up the heart on the ground first: it goes into your heart slot…
tutorial.wait.callSend: {name} is walking away so that your call means something: hold on a moment…
